digest.component_or_area: git hooks and commit message validation
propositions: Commit messages with body lines exceeding 72 characters or subjects exceeding 50 characters must be rejected locally at commit time, with named offending lines and character counts.
The commit-msg hook must preserve Gerrit's Change-Id stamping by chaining it as commit-msg.legacy in migration mode, not overwriting it.

Body lines matching trailer regex (^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9-]*:\s), tag pattern (^[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]*=), fenced code blocks (^\s*```), 4+ space/tab indentation, table rows (|), or atomic unsplittable tokens (URLs/paths/identifiers) must be exempted from the 72-column limit.
The checker must ignore git scaffolding including comment lines and the verbose diff below the >8 marker without false positives.
The make hooks target must verify both pre-commit and commit-msg hook installation, exit non-zero if either hook file is absent, and warn (exit zero) if Change-Id stamping is not found.
